description: A map argument with a key its parameter's object type lacks becomes that object, without the key
notes: The spec makes this an error however the call is read: the map doesn't match the object type, and converting a map whose keys don't exactly match the object type's attributes is an error. hashicorp/hcl converts arguments to their parameter's type, and go-cty's map to object conversion skips map keys that aren't attributes of the object type (conversionMapToObject in cty/convert/conversion_collection.go), so c is dropped.
